A '''glaive''' was a type of extended [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] consisting of an elongated shaft with a curved [[Knife/Legends|blade]] attached at the end, allowing for a longer range of attack than traditional [[Sword/Legends|swords]]. They could be used during combat, as well as when [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] [[Species/Legends|animals]]. These [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] were used sometime during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Reveal" />
